pages.title: Santa Claus Carrying a Sack of Christmas Presents Past a Snow-covered Cottage Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Santa Claus carrying a sack of Christmas presents past a snow-covered cottage, with wrapped boxes and a candy cane above his shoulder. A wreath, lantern, and shuttered window decorate the cottage. The coloring sheet pairs Santa's broad coat and sack with smaller snowy village details.

pages.title: Santa Claus Riding a Reindeer-drawn Sleigh Above Christmas Eve Rooftops Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Santa Claus riding a reindeer-drawn sleigh above Christmas Eve rooftops, waving beneath a large moon while holding the reins. Two reindeer wear bell collars ahead of the curved sleigh. Stars, wrapped gifts, snowy roofs, and narrow harness straps provide varied details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Santa Claus Kneeling Beside a Brick Chimney with a Wrapped Christmas Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Santa Claus kneeling beside a brick chimney with a wrapped Christmas gift, holding its ribboned box above the snowy rim. His fur-trimmed suit and long beard fill most of the scene. The coloring sheet adds smaller rectangular sections in the chimney bricks, roof tiles, and present.

pages.title: Santa Claus Reading a Child's Christmas Letter in an Armchair Beside a Toy Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Santa Claus reading a child's Christmas letter in an armchair, with a toy sack beside his boots and ornaments behind. A teddy bear, toy train, ball, and wrapped box fill the sack. The coloring sheet combines broad chair cushions with small toy details and braided drawstrings.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Building a Wooden Toy Train at Santa's Workshop Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas elf building a wooden toy train at Santa's workshop bench, holding a hammer above a peg on the engine. Loose blocks and dowels lie beside the train's wheels. A rocking horse, shelves, and snowy window add background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mrs. Claus Decorating Star-shaped Christmas Cookies in Her Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mrs. Claus decorating star-shaped Christmas cookies in her kitchen, piping icing beside a tray, cooling rack, and bowls of toppings. Holly decorates her hair above round glasses and a ruffled apron. Snowflake icing patterns and dotted cookies add fine details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rudolph Wearing a Jingle-bell Collar Beside the North Pole Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Rudolph wearing a jingle-bell collar beside the North Pole sign, standing in snow with branching antlers and an upturned tail. The arrow-shaped sign is blank on a striped post capped with snow. The coloring sheet leaves broad spaces around Rudolph and smaller enclosed bell shapes.

pages.title: The Grinch in a Santa Suit Carrying a Sack of Christmas Presents Beside Max Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Grinch in a Santa suit carrying a sack of Christmas presents beside Max, who wears a single strapped antler. The Grinch rests one hand on a hip beneath a curved smile. Fur trim, ribboned gifts, and Max's shaggy outline add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Decorated with Round Ornaments, a Star Topper, and Presents Underneath Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas tree decorated with round ornaments, draped bead garlands, and a large star topper above four ribboned presents. Layered branches divide the tree into broad sections. The coloring sheet offers repeating small bead circles alongside larger baubles, gift boxes, and open spaces within the bows.

pages.title: Child Hanging a Bell Ornament on a Small Christmas Tree Beside a Box of Decorations Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a child hanging a bell ornament on a small Christmas tree beside an open decoration box, wearing a snowflake-patterned sweater. Round baubles, a bow, and wrapped garland already cover the potted tree. The coloring sheet includes narrow sweater details and broad clothing and box panels.

pages.title: Christmas Ornaments with Snowflake, Stripe, and Star Patterns Hanging From a Fir Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features three Christmas ornaments hanging from a fir branch, with snowflake, stripe, and star patterns inside their large round outlines. Long suspension threads connect each bauble to the needle-covered branch. The coloring sheet combines broad curved bands with smaller star points, ornament caps, and fine evergreen needles.

pages.title: Christmas Wreath Made of Holly Leaves, Berries, Pinecones, and a Large Ribbon Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas wreath made of pointed holly leaves, berry clusters, four pinecones, and a large ribbon bow at the bottom. An open center separates the circular arrangement from its surrounding details. The coloring sheet combines broad bow loops with narrow leaf veins and repeating pinecone scales.

pages.title: Christmas Stocking Filled with a Teddy Bear, Candy Canes, and Small Wrapped Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas stocking filled with a teddy bear, two candy canes, and small wrapped presents above a wide fluffy cuff. A hanging loop rises behind the bear's head. The coloring sheet offers a large plain stocking body with smaller ribbon bows, candy stripes, and stitched patches.

pages.title: Christmas Bells Tied Together with a Ribbon and Holly Sprigs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features two Christmas bells tied together with a large ribbon bow, pointed holly leaves, and berry clusters above their flared openings. Round clappers hang inside the tilted bells. The coloring sheet pairs broad bell surfaces and ribbon tails with smaller suspension rings and fine leaf veins.

pages.title: Crossed Christmas Candy Canes Tied with a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows two crossed Christmas candy canes tied with a large bow, with curved stripes following each hooked top above the central knot. Long ribbon tails overlap the lower candy stems. The coloring sheet uses bold outlines and broad stripe sections against a plain background.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man with Icing Buttons and a Bow Tie Beside Star-shaped Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a smiling gingerbread man with icing buttons and a bow tie beside star-shaped cookies, raising one arm above wavy icing cuffs. Dotted icing and smaller stars decorate the surrounding cookies. The coloring sheet leaves large body areas between the round buttons and curved icing bands.

pages.title: Gingerbread House with Peppermint Pillars, Icing Roof Tiles, and a Gumdrop Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a gingerbread house with peppermint pillars, icing roof tiles, and a gumdrop path leading to a heart-decorated arched door. Swirled lollipops stand beside the walkway beneath a candy-dotted roof. The coloring sheet includes repeating sweets, window frames, and narrow icing borders around larger wall sections.

pages.title: Christmas Cookie Platter Filled with Tree, Star, Mitten, and Ornament Shapes Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas cookie platter filled with tree, star, mitten, and ornament shapes, layered inside a round plate with holly decorations. Snowflake icing, dots, and wavy bands distinguish the cookies. The coloring sheet has many enclosed decorative sections, with larger spaces inside the trees and mittens.

pages.title: Christmas Hot Chocolate Mug with Marshmallows and a Candy Cane Beside a Gingerbread Cookie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas hot chocolate mug with marshmallows and a candy cane beside a smiling gingerbread cookie wearing a bow tie. A large snowflake and wavy dotted bands decorate the mug. The coloring sheet adds holly berries below, with broad cup sections around the smaller patterns.

pages.title: Christmas Pudding Topped with Icing, Holly Leaves, and Berries on a Serving Plate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas pudding topped with dripping icing, three holly leaves, and a berry cluster above a rounded dotted dessert on a plate. The serving plate has a wavy decorative band around its edge. Broad icing areas and scattered small fruit shapes divide the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Snowman Wearing a Top Hat and Scarf Beside a Decorated Fir Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas snowman wearing a holly-trimmed top hat and striped scarf beside a decorated fir tree with a star topper. The snowman raises twig arms above a row of buttons. Round ornaments and bead garlands create smaller repeating shapes across the tree on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Snowflake Ornament with Six Branching Arms Hanging From a Ribbon Loop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas snowflake ornament with six branching arms, a circular center, and pointed tips suspended beneath a long ribbon loop. Each arm repeats the same angular side branches. The coloring sheet keeps the background blank, emphasizing the symmetrical outline and narrow sections within the hanging ribbon.

pages.title: Christmas Snow Globe Containing a Miniature Village and a Decorated Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas snow globe containing a miniature village and decorated tree, with snowy rooftops, a church tower, and an arched bridge. Small snow circles fill the globe above a bow-trimmed base. The coloring sheet includes fine architectural details alongside larger tree branches and ribbon panels.

pages.title: Christmas Nutcracker Soldier Standing Beside a Rocking Horse and a Wrapped Present Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas nutcracker soldier standing beside a rocking horse and wrapped present, wearing a tall plumed hat and buttoned uniform. The horse has a curved rocker, saddle, and hanging stirrup. The coloring sheet includes narrow jacket braids, boot decorations, and ribbon loops around larger toy sections.

pages.title: Christmas Gnome Holding a Wrapped Present at a Doorway Decorated with Evergreen Garland Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas gnome holding a wrapped present at a doorway decorated with evergreen garland, berry clusters, and a large overhead bow. A long pointed hat curls above the gnome's beard. Lanterns and small potted fir trees frame the figure, adding fine needle details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Fireplace with Hanging Stockings, a Log Basket, and Garland Across the Mantel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas fireplace with three hanging stockings, a log basket, and evergreen garland draped across the mantel beneath candles and a lantern. Snowflake, tree, and star designs distinguish the stockings. The coloring sheet includes individual masonry blocks, curling flames, woven basket lines, and smaller ornament details.

pages.title: Christmas Presents with Ribbons and Bows Stacked on a Wooden Sled Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Christmas presents with ribbons and bows stacked on a wooden sled, with stars, dots, and stripes decorating the gift boxes. Large bow loops overlap the rectangular packages above curved runners. The coloring sheet adds wood-grain lines and small fasteners beneath the broad wrapping-paper panels.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Lettering Surrounded By Holly, Candy Canes, and Hanging Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Merry Christmas lettering surrounded by holly, candy canes, and hanging ornaments, with large curling letters centered above a ribbon bow. Snowflake, star, stripe, and zigzag patterns decorate the baubles overhead. The coloring sheet balances broad letter interiors with smaller berries, leaf veins, and evergreen needles.

pages.title: Christmas Nativity with Mary and Joseph Beside Baby Jesus in a Manger Under the Stable Roof Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas Nativity with Mary and Joseph beside Baby Jesus in a manger under the stable roof, with animals behind. Joseph holds a staff while Mary reaches toward the swaddled baby. Straw textures, wooden beams, robe folds, a donkey, and a cow fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Shepherd Carrying a Staff and Leading Sheep Toward Bethlehem Beneath the Christmas Star Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a shepherd carrying a staff and leading sheep toward Bethlehem beneath the Christmas star, with three sheep along a rocky path. A walled town and domed buildings rise beyond the hills. The coloring sheet combines broad robe folds with smaller wool curves, stones, and distant windows.

pages.title: Three Wise Men Carrying Gifts Beside Their Camels Beneath the Star of Bethlehem Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows three Wise Men carrying gifts beside their camels beneath the Star of Bethlehem, with long robes, decorated headwear, and lidded vessels. Three saddled camels stand behind the figures near distant buildings. Fine robe borders, tassels, and container patterns add detailed sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Angel Holding a Trumpet Above the Rooftops of Bethlehem Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas angel holding a trumpet above Bethlehem rooftops, with spread feathered wings, a halo, and a flowing belted robe. A large star shines among smaller outlined stars overhead. The coloring sheet pairs broad wing and fabric sections with small windows, palm fronds, and distant buildings.

pages.title: Christmas Church with a Wreath on Its Door, Snow on Its Roof, and a Bell Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas church with a wreath on its door, snow across its steep roof, and a bell tower topped by a cross. Tall pointed windows flank the arched entrance above snowy steps. The coloring sheet leaves broad wall panels between narrow window frames, evergreen branches, and wreath details.

pages.title: Advent Wreath with Four Candles, Pine Sprigs, Berries, and Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features an Advent wreath with four lit candles, pine sprigs, berry clusters, holly leaves, and a large ribbon bow at the front. Dripping wax borders the candles below their outlined flames. The coloring sheet contrasts tall open candle shapes with closely spaced needles and small round berries.

pages.title: Children Singing Christmas Carols Beneath a Streetlamp Decorated with Evergreen Garland Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows three children singing Christmas carols beneath a streetlamp decorated with evergreen garland, wearing pompom hats, scarves, coats, and winter boots. The middle child holds an open songbook while the others sing beside it. The coloring sheet includes broad clothing panels with smaller garland and mitten details.

pages.title: Christmas Pickup Truck Carrying a Fir Tree Along a Snowy Farm Lane Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas pickup truck carrying a fir tree along a snowy farm lane, with a fenced field and barn behind. The vintage-style truck has rounded fenders, circular headlights, and wooden bed rails. The coloring sheet includes broad body panels beside finer grille bars, branches, and tire outlines.

pages.title: Christmas Toy Train Carrying Presents Around the Base of a Decorated Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas toy train carrying presents around the base of a decorated tree, with two loaded wagons on a circular track. Bows, bead garlands, stars, and patterned baubles cover the branches. The coloring sheet includes small train wheels, track ties, ribbon loops, and broad evergreen sections.

pages.title: Christmas Village Street with Decorated Shop Windows, Snowy Rooftops, and a Clock Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas village street with decorated shop windows, snowy rooftops, and a clock tower rising above a winding empty lane. Wreaths, garlands, potted trees, and wrapped gifts line the storefronts. The coloring sheet contains many small window frames and ornaments around the broader road and roof spaces.

pages.title: Christmas Log Cabin with a Snow-covered Porch, a Door Wreath, and Evergreen Window Garlands Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas log cabin with a snow-covered porch, door wreath, and evergreen window garlands tied with bows beneath a steep roof. A stone chimney rises beside the upper window. The coloring sheet includes rounded log ends, narrow porch rails, steps, and broad snow-covered areas.

pages.title: Christmas Poinsettia Plant in a Woven Basket Beside Fallen Petals and Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas poinsettia plant in a woven basket beside fallen petals and leaves, with three large flower clusters above overlapping foliage. Fine branching veins cross the pointed plant shapes. The coloring sheet adds small round flower centers and repeating basket strips beneath broad leaves and bracts.

pages.title: Christmas Holly Sprig with Berry Clusters and a Tied Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas holly sprig with three berry clusters and a tied ribbon, with pointed leaves spreading from several long stems. Fine veins divide the leaves above two broad bow loops. The coloring sheet has a plain background around the small berries, ribbon tails, and branching plant outline.

pages.title: Christmas Lights Draped Across a Long Evergreen Garland with Hanging Star Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Christmas lights draped across a long evergreen garland with five hanging star ornaments, berry clusters, and bows at both ends. The garland curves downward toward the largest central star. The coloring sheet combines narrow needles and bulb outlines with broader ribbon panels and faceted star sections.

pages.title: Christmas Mistletoe Bundle Suspended From a Ribbon Bow Above a Doorway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas mistletoe bundle suspended from a ribbon bow above a doorway, with oval leaves and round berries hanging centrally. Two wall lanterns flank the paneled door beneath a broad frame. The coloring sheet pairs small botanical details with larger door panels, ribbon loops, and rectangular trim.

pages.title: Christmas Kitten Peeking Out of a Stocking Hanging From a Low Wooden Peg Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas kitten peeking out of a stocking hanging from a low wooden peg, with both paws over a fluffy cuff. Zigzag bands and flowerlike snowflakes decorate the stocking below the kitten's striped forehead. The coloring sheet includes broad fabric sections alongside fine whiskers, fur strokes, and peg grain.

pages.title: Christmas Puppy Wearing a Santa Hat Beside an Open Gift Box and Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas puppy wearing a Santa hat beside an open gift box and loose ribbon, sitting with floppy ears and an open-mouth smile. The box lid leans behind the empty package. The coloring sheet leaves broad areas inside the puppy, hat, and box beside smaller fur contours.

pages.title: Christmas Penguin Wearing Earmuffs and a Scarf Beside a Small Sled Piled with Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas penguin wearing earmuffs and a scarf beside a small sled piled with presents, resting one flipper near the boxes. Dots, stripes, and ribbon bows distinguish the gifts. The coloring sheet has broad belly and scarf sections with smaller earmuff edges and wooden sled details.

pages.title: Christmas Polar Bear Cub Wearing a Santa Hat and Carrying a Gift Through the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas polar bear cub wearing a Santa hat and carrying a gift through the snow, with one foot lifted forward. A large bow tops the box held between both paws. The coloring sheet contrasts open gift panels and snowy ground with smaller fur marks and hat trim.

pages.title: Christmas Mandala Made of Ornaments, Candy Canes, Holly Leaves, and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a Christmas mandala made of ornaments, candy canes, holly leaves, and stars arranged around a large faceted central star. Patterned baubles repeat between striped candy hooks and berry clusters. The coloring sheet offers many small enclosed details within its circular, evenly spaced decorative design.

pages.title: Christmas Sweater Decorated with Reindeer, Fir Trees, and Snowflake Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas sweater decorated with reindeer, fir trees, and snowflake patterns, with zigzag borders dividing rows across the body and sleeves. Ribbing outlines the neck, cuffs, and hem. The coloring sheet combines repeating small motifs with broader fabric bands between the detailed seasonal shapes.

pages.title: Christmas Toy Workshop with a Sleigh outside Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features the North Pole Christmas workshop with a candy-cane gate, toy shelves inside open doors, and a curled sleigh waiting outside. A wreath hangs beneath the round attic window above the snowy roofline. The coloring sheet includes toy vehicles, a teddy bear, balls, and narrow striped posts.
